'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Battle of Khartoum (2023–2025)|Battle of Khartoum]]
***The [[Sudanese Air Force]] launches [[airstrike]]s in [[Khartoum]], killing at least 17 people and destroying dozens of homes. The [[Sudanese Armed Forces|armed forces]] and the [[Rapid Support Forces]] agree to a 72-hour [[ceasefire]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-65938868 (BBC News)]

**At least ten people are killed during an [[offensive (military)|offensive]] by the [[military of Cameroon]] against [[separatist]]s in the [[English-speaking]] [[Northwest Region (Cameroon)|Northwest Region]]. [https://english.news.cn/20230617/693db70a7bc34d8ba12b380b169b5f2d/c.html (Xinhua)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Asia heat wave]]
**At least 96 people die during a [[heat wave]], which started two days ago, in the states of [[Uttar Pradesh]] and [[Bihar]], [[India]]. [https://apnews.com/article/india-uttar-pradesh-bihar-heat-wave-deaths-03e68826845734d1a703851b23de6849 (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Saudi Arabia–Yemen relations]]
**A [[Yemenia]] flight with 277 passengers departs from [[Sanaa International Airport]] for [[Jeddah]]'s [[King Abdulaziz International Airport]], the first [[commercial flight]] from [[Yemen]]'s primary [[international airport]] to [[Saudi Arabia]] after a seven-year [[Blockade of Yemen|blockade]]. Additional flights have been scheduled to accommodate thousands of [[Hajj]] pilgrims. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20230617-plane-leaves-yemen-capital-for-saudi-first-since-2016 (AFP via France 24)]
